r05-ana-apples.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) stands at her light wooden dining table and smiles, holding out a red apple toward the right; four more red apples lie on the table; the blurred hair and shoulder of a guest show at the right edge; her living room behind.
r05-ana-apples.note: Usable as the finale's answer view: some apples on the table, offered by Ana; the guest at the edge is only a blur and is not the subject of the answer.
